headline: Angola Annual Inflation Slows to 8.16% in October
summary: Angola’s inflation eased to 8.16% in October from 8.43% in September, with food remaining the largest driver of rising prices.
why: Inflation trends in Angola guide the central bank's monetary policy stance and macroeconomic stability assessments.

impacts.name: Angola
impacts.why: Cooling inflation rates indicate a moderation in price pressures for the domestic economy.
